style:
Accent: Nigerian English. Tone: warm, clear and upbeat, at a steady natural pace.

Transcript:

lines.c_intro: Welcome to Klasync, where every lecture is captioned live, and ready to study.
lines.s1: The lecturer signs in, reviews the class roster, and starts a live session.
lines.s2: Students join from their phones using the session code.
lines.s3: As the lecturer speaks, Gemini transcribes the audio, and captions appear instantly on every student's phone.
lines.s4: Check-ins, raised hands, and questions reach the lecturer in real time.
lines.s5: Meanwhile, an A.I. summary builds as the lecture goes.
lines.s6a: With one tap, the lecturer launches an A.I. quiz.
lines.s6b: Gemini writes a question from what was just taught. Students answer on their phones, and the results update live.
lines.s7: When class ends, attendance is scored automatically, and rolled into course analytics.
lines.c_mid: After class, everything is waiting in the student's archive.
lines.t1: On mobile, the student signs in to their lecture archive.
lines.t2: The transcript is searchable, and synced to the recording.
lines.t3: A.I. chapters let them jump to any moment.
lines.t3b: And the summary captures the key ideas.
lines.t4: An interactive concept map shows how the ideas connect.
lines.t5: Flashcards are generated straight from the lecture.
lines.t6: The new quiz tests understanding, with instant feedback and explanations.
lines.t7: Students can also ask the lecture a question, and every answer cites the moment it came from.
lines.c_out: Klasync. Every lecture, accessible to all.
